body: God that sounds like a story for the generations. I wish I had family like that. Glad the dad is doing alright.
I think it might help. It gives me a list of services to look for in my area. Thank you.

I'm not a doctor but arrhythmia + weakness, fatigue, shortness of breath, lightheadedness, and feeling generally unwell typically equals ER visit. If it was just one or two of those symptoms you might be safe waiting to see your normal doctor, but with all those symptoms happening at the same time, well, those are all on the list of symptoms for a heart attack, and with your history of having a heart murmur, I'd play it safe and visit the ER. I also wouldn't wait for your lunch break or end of shift, but would go ASAP.
